questions.stem_text:
To produce light, the atoms inside a light bulb transform electrical energy into what
other kind of energy?

Which of the following is the primary type of stress that a fixed vise exerts on a piece
of wood?
Why is water from an aquifer more likely to be cleaner than water from other sources?

options.A: because it forms where fresh and salt water meet
options.B: because it receives water directly from precipitation
options.C: because it rises to the surface near the ocean
options.D: because pollutants are filtered by rock and soil deep within Earth

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - because pollutants are filtered by rock and soil deep within Earth

questions.stem_text: Which form of energy can travel through a vacuum?
What is the major process of surface rock formation on volcanoes?

options.A: Rock cools quickly from melted rock.
options.B: Rock is recrystallized by extreme pressure.
options.D: Rock is formed from deposited sediment.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Rock cools quickly from melted rock.
